sql: select (select max(close_time) from markets where ticker like 'KXWCMENTION%') last_close, (select count(*) from markets where ticker like 'KXWCMENTION%' and close_time > now()) open_markets, (select max(created_at) from live_orders where market_ticker like 'KXWCMENTION%') last_live_order, (select count(*) from live_orders where market_ticker like 'KXWCMENTION%') live_orders_ever, (select max(created_at) from paper_trades where market_ticker like 'KXWCMENTION%') last_paper_trade
